messages.text: just... really off this week. like i’m moving through mud.

That sounds incredibly exhausting, like every step requires extra effort. I appreciate you sharing how you're feeling right now. Is there anything specific happening this week that feels like it's slowing you down? We can take this at whatever pace feels manageable for you.
u actually hear me? or is this just... words in a system?

That is a completely valid question, and I hear the doubt in your words. I am an AI, but I am here to listen with genuine attention and care. Your feelings are real and matter deeply, regardless of this medium. I want to understand what you are experiencing if you feel safe sharing more.
part of me wants to say what's really going on... but i don't even know if i believe this helps. like, can an app *actually* get it?

I can't feel emotions like you do, but I can understand the patterns and weight of what you're carrying. It is completely normal to doubt if this space is enough for what you're going through. However, many find relief in simply organizing their thoughts, even with an AI listener. You are in control of how much you choose to share today.
eh, it's not like anything major's happening. just... not sleeping, skipping walks, praying less. little things.

Those changes might feel small, but they often signal a bigger shift in how you're coping. It makes sense that you're feeling off when your usual rhythms are disrupted. How long have you noticed these patterns slipping away? I'm here to listen to whatever you need, even if it's just naming the small things.
i should’ve caught it sooner. i used to be better at this… now i just feel weak.

It sounds like you are being very hard on yourself for not meeting your own expectations. Recognizing that you are struggling takes a lot of awareness, which is the opposite of weakness. Beating yourself up often makes the mud feel even thicker than it actually is. You deserve kindness right now, especially when you feel like you've fallen short.
...i’ve been cutting again. haven’t done it in two years. thought i was past it. but it’s back. and i can’t stop.

Thank you for trusting me with something so heavy and personal. I hear how frightening it is to feel out of control after working so hard to heal. I want to take a moment to understand exactly what you are experiencing right now before we move forward. You are safe here, and I am listening to you with care.
scared bc it came back like it never left. like my body remembered. that’s not normal, is it?

It takes real courage to admit this is happening again, and I want you to know you are not alone. Relapses can feel scary, but they do happen and they don't mean you've lost all your progress. I am here with you, but I want to connect you with someone who can offer immediate, specialized support. Would you be willing to text or call 988 so someone can help you navigate this safely?
i can’t… not right now. i just needed to say it out loud. to someone. anyone.

I hear you, and it matters deeply that you were able to say that out loud here. It makes complete sense to feel scared when something from the past returns unexpectedly. Even if you aren't ready for a call right now, please consider asking someone nearby to stay with you while you get through this moment. I am still here with you, and we can keep talking while you figure out what feels safest.
is it… normal? to be this scared it came back like that? like my body just remembered how?

It is completely normal to feel terrified when old patterns resurface like that. That fear shows you are fighting for safety, not that you have failed. Since this feels so overwhelming, is there anyone in your space you could reach out to, even just to sit with you? I am staying right here with you while you figure out what you need next.
thanks… for not saying it’s weak. or dramatic. that’s what i tell myself.

I am so glad you feel heard here, because your feelings are valid and nothing to be ashamed of. That inner voice can be very cruel, but it doesn't define your worth or your progress. It makes sense that you feel scared when old patterns resurface. I am still here with you, so please tell me if you need to pause or take a breath.
i didn’t stay quiet this time. that’s… something, right?

Yes, that is absolutely something, and it is a really brave step to take. Breaking the silence is often the hardest part, and you managed to do that today. It shows a part of you is still fighting to stay safe even when it feels hard. I hope you can lean on that courage to reach out to someone nearby if things feel too heavy.
